notes.title: Course Creator Added!
notes.notes:
Hello Again,

One of the biggest new features that I have been working on for DGA2 is a course creator.  From the start I always wanted to include this in DGA1 as well but just hadn't gotten around to it.  Once I had a functioning version in DGA2 I just had to come back and implement that feature here as well.

Players can now create up to 5 custom courses for each area.  All courses are fully editable as well, so the possibilities are truly endless.  Placing objects is as simple as positioning them in the desired location and clicking the trigger button.  If you want to adjust the object that is easy too, just click the "Move" button.  You can also teleport directly to an object to help you move around quickly.  Once you are done designing your course just click the "Finish" button and you will be ready to play.

I hope this feature will provide new opportunities for those who have always wanted to design their own courses.  Have fun!

-Brian[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049877/6b47eb6c5a988720dcc41e000047ab77d9c63470.png[/img]

notes.title: Various Updates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049877/c1adfae2ea193a7ca63818ee3594afe80ae4d6b6.png[/img]Hey Everyone,

It's been a while since this game has been updated, and in the meantime DGA2 has been in work.  While I've been working on that game I've made a few updates that I thought would be beneficial for this game as well.  Two of these have been implemented in the most recent update:

Throw Adjuster: you can use this to tweak the release of your discs, both up/down and left/right.  You can also set the adjustment to scale with your distance from the basket.  As an example, this could be useful if for long throws you want the disc to come out more to the left or right, but for short putts you still want it to fly straight.

Pointing/Teleporting: the pointer should now activate automatically when you are pointing at a valid object, rather than requiring the thumbstick/touchpad to be pressed in.  This should be more intuitive for newer players and easier for current players.  Also, I removed the "touch" teleporting option and changed it to a "tilt" option.  This should also be more intuitive, as the "touch" option seemed to sensitive to me and more likely for an accidental teleportation.  Speaking of which, you can now choose if you want to be able to teleport with the left controller, the right controller, or both.

That's it for now, but I'll be looking at implementing other updates as well in the near future.

Happy Holidays!
-Brian

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049877/ad50d5fa17f81dd9c728d936a4de2241d8a683d2.png[/img]
Online multiplayer has now been added for all courses in the Mystic Mountains and Albatross Lake areas.  The same capabilities will soon be added for all courses in the Maple Valley area as well.  The interface is still a bit basic for now, but to start a multiplayer game just select a course as usual and click on the blue "start multiplayer" button.  Up to 4 players can play together at once.  Please let me know if you run into any issues, and if you want a golfing buddy to play a round with, feel free to shoot me a message so we can plan a time to play.

Thanks,
Brian

notes.title: New Course, Various Updates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049877/cfd0747875d252b79e027a6922b4bed158f7687f.png[/img]Hello Everyone!

In the latest updates, the 11th course has been added, Maple Valley No. 4.  This course is a bit shorter than recent courses but more technical.  As always, good luck and have fun!

I also decided to tweak the flight characteristics of the discs a bit.  Before when they were thrown at aggressive angles, the amount of turn/fade seemed a bit too drastic to me.  I've toned this done and I think it feels much better to me, but for those real life disc golfers who are much better than I am, please let me know what you think! 

Along similar lines, I made understable discs act a bit more understable.  Now you can get a nice turn on a disc, whereas before it would tend to quickly flex back and fade early in the flight.  I also updated the discs to show negative numbers.  This was previously the intent with my flight rating system using only positive numbers, but it was a bit confusing to those who play disc golf in real life, so I've changed this to be more consistent for those players.
   
Lastly, I implemented a change to the teleportation coding such that the player will no longer teleport on top of the basket if the disc stops there.  Instead the player will teleport just to the side of the basket.

-Brian

notes.title: New Course / Physics Update
notes.notes:
The 9th course was just added to the game (5th added since release): DGC East in the Mystic Mountains area.  This is a long and challenging course, so good luck and have fun with it!  The release point for discs was also modified to make it more accurate/consistent across various headsets.  For experienced players this may take a little bit of adjusting to get used to; the release point may seem a bit earlier at first.  However I do believe the release point is more accurate overall, and it will fix many of the issues that players were experiencing with some of the newer headsets out on the market.  If anyone finds that this has been over-corrected too far, let me know and I might look at adding options to choose between different release points.

A couple of leaderboard bugs were also fixed, and all courses now have functioning leaderboards as well.

-Brian[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049877/7862f2d4b82b1a264d5c097bf11c185e852bb86b.png[/img]

notes.title: Physics Update, New Course!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049877/91d9296d531d9ef26488a42457b5280c7411ff1d.jpg[/img]Thanks to everyone who has tried out the game during the first week since release!  A couple of quick announcements:

Based on user feedback, I've tweak the physics a bit so that discs should fly farther right from the get-go.  I also understand that the disc flights tend to differ from headset to headset (specifically the initial release points, some tend to be biased to one direction), so I am currently working on ways to make them behave more consistently.

A new course has also been added!  This is the Monument Course, and it can be played in the Albatross Lake area.  Additional courses and an additional area will be added over the coming months.

If you have any thoughts or feedback for improvement, please let us know!

-Brian
